page_update_policy: Only guides declared in data/restaurant-guides/manifest.json may be rendered or linked from the public archive. Create new regions with scripts/create_restaurant_guide.py; do not copy an old region HTML file as a visual baseline.

manifest.archiveRule: Any public archive href for a manifest guide must equal its archiveHref.
manifest.aliasRule: A shareAlias is generated from the rendered output digest; hand-edited cache keys are not permitted.

distance.sadangStationMethod: Use the verified Sadang Station coordinate, calculate straight-line distance to verified venue coordinates, and round display values to 10m.

renderer.input: Top-level general array is required, bohe array is optional, and config plus modeConfig provide every regional display value.
renderer.template_rule: The canonical template contains no region, radius, category, venue-name, or mode-specific quick-pick logic.
renderer.food_filters: Generate FOOD filter buttons from the active mode's venue categories.

tabs.zeroBoheCandidates: Hide the entire tab control with display:none and render only 일반 추천.
tabs.positiveBoheCandidates: Render switchable in-place 일반 추천 and 보헤 추천 tabs; the selected tab alone supplies metrics, marker rail, quick picks, and cards.

actions.distinctDestinationRule: Render both 지도 and 검색 링크 actions as separate controls with distinct destinations: Naver Map Place search and Naver integrated search.
actions.savedSourceRule: For a Bohe venue, show exactly one representative reference source URL even if the private DB has multiple Instagram or blog URLs.

quickPicks.role: Each card presents a user decision: a purpose title, a bold venue plus distance, and one concise fit sentence.
quickPicks.deduplication: The fit sentence must not repeat the quick-pick venue name or its displayed distance; mention only a distinct comparison venue when needed.
quickPicks.comparisonEmphasis: A distinct comparison venue plus distance in the fit sentence must be declared in highlights and rendered with the same strong emphasis as the primary venue plus distance.

boheCards.tabMeaning: 보헤 추천 is a candidate-source tab, not a different recommendation product. It uses the same regional goal, decision-oriented BEST FOR, quick-pick hierarchy, and venue-fit copy as 일반 추천.
boheCards.provenancePlacement: The tab label and reference action convey provenance. Never put DB, 저장, source provenance, or 후보 wording in BEST FOR, quick-pick titles/copy, venue reason, or rationale.
boheCards.naverSignalRule: NAVER SIGNAL contains only Naver visitor and blog metrics; never place 보헤 DB or source provenance there.

addressDisplay.layoutRule: Use a factually shortened address that fits on one line; never wrap, ellipsize, or invent an address.
